summary: Two Palestinians were treated for live-fire wounds while settlers and IDF troops entered al-Mughayyir; same-event footage shows settlers/troops near homes and an IDF detention, while local Palestinian reporting alleges troops fired on residents during an attempted livestock theft.
resolution_notes: The two gunshot injuries and joint settler/IDF presence are credibly reported, but shooter attribution and incident sequence remain unresolved. WAFA attributes the shootings to IDF snipers based on the village council head; Times of Israel reports the injuries and joint entry but says details were unclear and the IDF had not responded. Do not assign settler or military responsibility for the gunfire until stronger event-level corroboration or an IDF/police response surfaces.
media_status: Exact same-event footage exists for the entry/detention context, but no exact shooting footage was recovered. No canonical media or substitute imagery added while attribution remains unresolved.
